videos.description:
Ford has unveiled a new social campaign for BlueCruise, its hands-free eyes on driving technology, created in partnership with global social-first creative agency, Born Social.
Building on Ford's wider, ‘Arrive Ready’ platform, the campaign demonstrates with two films how BlueCruise can help drivers feel more focused and prepared for the road ahead by reducing cognitive load during long journeys. Rather than relying on actors or fictional scenarios, Born Social brought the platform to life through the authentic stories of two elite athletes pursuing ambitious personal goals.
The campaign follows multidisciplinary adventure athlete Matthias Weger and renowned Scottish climber William Bosi as they travel to locations across Europe to take on challenges that push them beyond their limits.
For Weger, that meant training in northern Italy ahead of his attempt to defend his title at the world's largest extreme sports festival, Ekstremsportveko festival. For Bossi, it meant tackling Three Degrees of Separation in southeastern France, a demanding climbing route featuring dynamic movements outside his usual speciality.
At the heart of both films is the idea that preparation begins long before the challenge itself. Using BlueCruise during their journeys, the athletes are shown mentally rehearsing and visualising the tasks ahead while keeping their eyes on the road, arriving focused and ready to perform at their best.
To bring this idea to life visually, Born Social developed a series of cinematic match cuts that seamlessly transition between moments inside the vehicle and moments during performance. A tightening grip becomes a kayaking manoeuvre. A moment of concentration in the driver's seat becomes focused on the rock face. The result is a visual representation of how the mind prepares before the body acts.
Filmed on location across Italy and France, the campaign was designed to feel grounded in real experiences and genuine ambition. Both athletes selected goals they were already working towards, allowing the work to capture authentic moments.
Running across Ford's owned social channels in the UK, the campaign includes hero films, athlete collaborations, paid social amplification and creator-first cutdowns designed for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Assets will be available across Ford's European markets.

Paying homage to the cinematic language and visceral thrill of Jaws, this AI/CGI film uses familiar visual cues to build suspense around an unknown entity moving towards shore.

The beach scenes were prompted to evoke the warm, nostalgic feel of 1980’s film, creating a calm and familiar atmosphere, while the underwater and lurking danger sequences shift into colder blue tones as the tension builds.

Rather than revealing the threat immediately, the film uses underwater POVs, movement through the water and the menacing silhouette of a fin to hint at what’s about to happen. The payoff is the reveal of the BYD SHARK 6 emerging from the ocean.

A hybrid AI and CGI workflow was used throughout the production, with CGI previs guiding the AI-generated vehicle reveal, to control the camera movement, composition, timing and final arrival of the SHARK 6.

videos.description: CASHIN — The Journey of a Riyal transforms an invisible business challenge into a cinematic story. Instead of explaining operational losses through dashboards and reports, the film follows a single Saudi Riyal as the main character, turning it into a visual metaphor for the profits that silently disappear through everyday operational inefficiencies. Every frame was designed to make the audience experience financial leakage rather than simply understand it, using low-angle compositions, FPV ground-level cinematography, and a continuous visual journey that elevates an ordinary coin into a symbol of business value. The film never speaks about theft or blames people; instead, it delivers a subtle subliminal message that the greatest losses are often created by small, unnoticed processes repeated every day. As the Riyal finally reaches safety, the emotional narrative shifts from uncertainty to confidence, perfectly reflecting CASHIN's promise: giving business owners complete visibility, smarter decisions, and full control over every Riyal that matters. Created through an AI-first cinematic workflow combining concept development, image generation, motion design, editing, sound design, and voice-over, the project demonstrates how technology and storytelling can work together to transform complex operational insights into an emotional and memorable brand experience.

videos.description:
Throughout the year, in advertising, the “blank canvas” is synonymous with briefings, tight deadlines, and the constant search for ideas. A process that sometimes brings a harvest, and other times leaves behind deep exhaustion.

But in summer, the rules change. The blank canvas is no longer a challenge waiting for us to fill it quickly; it becomes the sea, the breeze, and the sun. It is the canvas itself that comes to free us from the weight of the year.

That is why, from La Caseta, we want to share our summer campaign with you: a modern Spanish Romance transformed into a song. A tribute to the need to pause, in order to find inspiration again.
La Caseta has created A Spanish Romance of the Blank Canvas as a metaphor for what it means to take on every briefing throughout the year, and what this blank canvas represents during the summer.
A deeply poetic campaign, both visually and conceptually, for which a poem has been created: a modern Spanish Romance of the blank canvas transformed into a song. The decision to create a modern Spanish romance in the form of a song comes from the role this poetic form has played in Spanish literature for centuries: a way of sharing stories, emotions, and collective memory. The romance brought poetry closer to people because its simple language and musical rhythm allowed anyone to hear it, learn it, and sing it. That is why, when speaking about something so universal within our industry, we felt it was the form that best represented the beauty, simplicity, and importance of what a blank canvas means during the summer.

In our profession, everything must be creative, impactful, and different. That is why it is often said that every time we are asked to create a campaign and begin a project from scratch, we are facing a blank canvas. And although we also encounter this blank canvas during the summer, when we step away from our work and allow ourselves to disconnect, it takes on a completely different meaning: we are no longer the ones filling the blank canvas; instead, it is the canvas that fills us with energy and frees us from the stress, exhaustion, and demanding deadlines we have carried throughout the rest of the year.

All of this can be seen throughout the poem. That is why, this summer, all of us who work in advertising and communication will continue creating and facing blank canvases with every campaign while we are in the office. But when we step outside, travel, or go on holiday, we will recharge and find inspiration in all the blank canvases we encounter: a window, the sea, a meal, the sun…
Because for us, summer is also a vast blank canvas of inspiring experiences, of things waiting to be felt and lived.

videos.description:
Preteen girls shouldn’t be singing to their own babies. 

In South Africa, girls as young as 10 are singing lullabies to babies they were never old enough to have. Amnesty International’s latest “Lullaby” campaign confronts the reality of the rise in children raising children. 

Unfortunately, public outrage only erupts when Christmas and New Year’s baby stories reveal that some of the mothers are children themselves. So Amnesty International and Joe Public decided to confront the matter head on. Lullabies are one of the first acts of love many of us experience as children. They represent safety, comfort, motherhood, and childhood itself. In each film, a young girl softly sings a lullaby as we move through her childhood home. By the end of the film, we discover the child is singing the lullaby to her own baby.

“By placing this familiar ritual in the hands of a child who should still be receiving it, we hope to expose the disturbing reality that 2103 girls between the ages of 10 and 14 gave birth in 2024,” says Amnesty International Director Shenilla Mohamed. “Most of these girls are forced to drop out of school or fall behind with their schoolwork. They become trapped in a cycle of poverty, leaving them dependent on public assistance, suffering the stigma of being pregnant and giving birth at a young age, or being forced into early marriages.”

Children do not have the capacity to consent to sexual activity, and sex with a child under 12 is always considered rape. Hidden behind closed doors and often accepted as someone else's problem, the issue is not being treated with the urgency it desperately deserves. To bring it to life, a whole team contributed their skills free of charge, including director Justice Mukheli of Romance Films.

Martin Schlumpf, Joe Public ECD, adds: “We wanted to take something universally gentle and turn it into a mirror that reflects a reality we’ve become far too comfortable overlooking – children being forced into adulthood far too soon. Justice brought a deeply human, restrained visual language to the films, capturing intimate moments with empathy and stillness that allows the reveal to land with real emotional impact, rather than feeling forced.”

videos.description:
DoorDash Canada has launched a new national campaign promoting its DashPass membership programme through a series of humorous, period drama-inspired films created with Wieden+Kennedy Toronto. Titled ‘Not That Dramatic’, the campaign exaggerates the familiar hesitation people feel before ordering food delivery, transforming everyday indecision into elaborate tales of longing and suspense. Directed by Steve Ayson, the first two spots, ‘The Forbidden Order’ and ‘For All OfUs’, use the conventions of classic romance to highlight the value of DashPass.

The campaign was inspired by the insight that many Canadians remain unaware of DashPass' benefits despite the programme already being available. By turning the simple decision to order delivery into an over-the-top emotional drama, the films contrast exaggerated hesitation with the practical advantages of DashPass, including $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees. One spot draws on the style of an 1800s forbidden romance, while the other recreates the emotional farewell of a 1970s train station goodbye, with both concluding that ordering in becomes much easier with DashPass.

Rolling out nationally in English and French across TV, CTV, online video, gaming and digital channels, the campaign is designed as the beginning of a broader creative platform exploring the idea of "drama and instant resolution". DoorDash Canada says the work not only raises awareness of DashPass but also showcases its value through humour, cinematic production and highly relatable everyday behaviour.

videos.description:
These days, the group trip rarely leaves the group chat, and friends across the U.S. are left with broken promises and unrealized travel dreams. New KAYAK research reveals that 84% of travelers have had a group trip that never made it beyond the planning stage, with plans spending an average of one to three months in group chat limbo. The culprit? 90% of travelers say it comes down to one friend who just won’t commit. 

In its new summer campaign, “Bookboards,” KAYAK is addressing this problem head-on by sending non-committal friends a booking reminder that’s impossible to ignore. Developed in partnership with lead creative agency, Rethink, the campaign calls out flaky friends in a real and interactive way: through a series of “bookboards,” billboard-sized reminders placed across New York, Chicago, and Los Angeles. The fleet of digital billboards will feature personalized callouts for nominated friends, popping up near their offices and neighborhoods that encourage them to commit, while inspiring bystanders to finally make that group trip happen. 

At the center of the campaign is a 74-second hero film starring actress, comedian, and content creator Grace Reiter alongside her real-life friend and American High co-star Julia Dicesare. The spot imagines what happens when group chat pressure spills into the real world, as increasingly impossible "Bookboards" follow Grace everywhere – from bus stops and Times Square to her latte foam and even a barking dog. In the end, Julia reveals that Grace has been the target all along: the friend who never commits to the trip, before inviting viewers to nominate their own travel procrastinator at kayak.com/bookboards. 

Travelers eager to book can nominate their group chat for a Bookboard from July 21 through August 4. Throughout August, KAYAK will select top submissions to appear on digital billboards across New York, Chicago and Los Angeles.

Beyond the hero spot and billboards, “Bookboards” extends across OLV, OOH, social content, earned media, and a landing page.

videos.description:
Ultimate Sevens, the new rugby sevens championship, has launched its global campaign ahead of the upcoming championship’s inaugural season starting in September.

The global campaign, "Don't Call It Rugby” was created by agency partner Brothers & Sisters and aims to challenge perceptions of rugby and introduce a new era for the sport. It puts Ultimate Sevens at the heart of culture and entertainment and reinvigorates rugby sevens.

The online film showcases the progressive nature of Ultimate Sevens and features leading rugby sevens players including Henry Hutchison, Maddi Levi, Thalia Costa and Manu Moreno. The messaging is bold, with lines including: "Don't call it Rugby, when this is a whole new era"; “Don't call it a kick-off, when it's a show starter"; "Don't call it stop-start, when it never lets up”; and "Don't call it old-school, when we're creating the next move".

The film highlights Ultimate Sevens’ innovative format, live events, player personalities, inclusive fan offering and commitment to elevating both the men's and women's game with complete parity.

Brothers & Sisters won the brief without a formal pitch in April and has created the spot using its AI studios, harnessing AI’s creative potential to stretch and play with the physics of rugby, combining real footage of the players into an AI world. 

The campaign - produced in English, French and Spanish - aims to drive excitement and engagement around Ultimate Sevens’ four European live events, in Leganes Madrid, Cardiff, Biarritz, and Brentford London, while attracting new audiences to the game.

Combining world-class sporting competition with entertainment, culture, lifestyle and fan-first experiences, Ultimate Sevens’ ambition is to enhance the rugby sevens ecosystem and help make it one of the most followed, enjoyed and engaged sporting disciplines in the world.

Reece Littlejohn, Global Marketing Director at Ultimate Sevens said: “‘Don’t Call It Rugby’ is more than a campaign line; it is a statement of intent for where we believe sevens can go, and will go, with the new Championship. Ultimate Sevens is here to reimagine the sport, the way it engages with new and existing fans and how it can connect with a new generation who want their live sport to feel faster, more accessible and more culturally relevant. 

“We want to create an experience that celebrates elite rugby sevens, and fans of the sport from across the world, while opening the door to new audiences through entertainment, storytelling and moments that live beyond the pitch.”

Matt Charlton CEO, at Brothers & Sisters, said: “We are lucky enough to have some of the best and most creative AI enabled storytellers in the world in the agency and we have used these skills to tell a fresh and disruptive story in sport that is breaking free into a new era where sport and entertainment are the same thing” 

For more information and ticket updates, visit www.ultimatesevens.com

LTA, the governing body of tennis in Britain, has launched a new advertising campaign encouraging families to give tennis a go. The accessibility campaign features the nation’s favourite celebrity couple, Stacey Solomon and Joe Swash giving tennis its own version of what a knockabout is for football, inviting Britain’s families to experience the fun to be had with a ball and a racket (or any similarly shaped object to hand).

videos.description:
The dust has settled, the turf is down, and the gates have officially opened. Carhartt, America's premium workwear brand, has once again partnered with the Buffalo Bills as they prepare to kick off their next era at the newly completed Highmark Stadium. To mark the occasion, Carhartt is shining a spotlight on the hardworking people behind-the-scenes who built the new Buffalo stage, as well as the tradespeople nationwide who supply the game's essential elements. This work comes together in the next chapter of Carhartt's creative brand campaign, Made Possible, which honors the tradespeople whose hard work shapes some of our beloved and iconic shared experiences.

In the first chapter of the Made Possible campaign, which launched in August 2025, Carhartt highlighted the early stages of Highmark Stadium's construction through the story of Bills legendary running back Thurman Thomas and his commercial construction company, 34 Group Inc., which was responsible for installing the seats in the new stadium. This fall, the campaign picks up where that story left off, with Thurman showcasing the dedication, craftsmanship and pride of his crew and the thousands of hardworking people who helped bring the stadium to life by giving current Bills star running back James Cook III his first tour of the state-of-the-art venue.

"Stadiums aren't just concrete and steel, they are monuments to what can happen when grit, skill, and purpose come together," said Norma Delaney, Vice President of Marketing and Brand Creative at Carhartt. "This season, we are proud to stand alongside Bills legend and construction leader Thurman Thomas, and current Bills running back James Cook III to honor the hardworking crews whose contributions are often overlooked but are critical to every game-day experience. From the first shovel in the ground to the opening kickoff, major construction projects like the new Highmark Stadium are made possible by hardworking people wearing Carhartt."

The campaign is anchored by a 30-second hero spot, "Making Football Possible," which is a unique, reverse-look from finish to start, beginning with the fans cheering, rewinding to the seats being installed, the sod being rolled, the uprights going in, and the footballs being created, because it takes a collective effort of hardworking skilled tradespeople to make game day possible. While the campaign is anchored in Buffalo, this fall's installment expands its lens to celebrate the workforce behind stadiums nationwide that support football year-round – from the sod to the uprights.

The campaign also includes two-minute longform, behind-the-scenes videos:
• Constructing Highmark Stadium alongside Thurman Thomas and his crew at 34 Group Inc.
• Carolina Green, the family-owned farm serving as one of the major natural grass suppliers for NFL stadiums across the country.
• Aluminum Athletic Equipment (AAE) and the skilled welders behind the uprights that define the end zone in multiple NFL stadiums.

This multi-year campaign celebrates the physical completion of Highmark Stadium while honoring the grit of the thousands of men and women who bring the game to life.

"It's an honor to take the field in this new stadium, but we know none of this happens without the crews who actually built the stage we play on," said James Cook III, Buffalo Bills Running Back. "Partnering with Carhartt and Thurman to officially pass the torch and thank the workers behind the scenes is the perfect way to kick off this exciting new chapter for Bills fans."

Additionally, when the Bills take the Highmark Stadium field for their first preseason home game on Saturday, Aug. 15, Carhartt will thank the hardworking people who brought the new stadium to life with a Rally Towel giveaway for the first 20,000 fans in attendance. The Rally Towels will be printed on the front and back and will feature the names of every person on the crews who worked on the new stadium. Carhartt will also run messaging in-stadium during the Bills preseason games to pay tribute to the crews.

methodology.main_doc:
# 品牌广告样片采集方案与优质判定标准

> 版本：v3（2026-08-01）  
> 目标市场：海外。  
> 目标：按“广告视频题材 × 行业 / 商品品类”收集既代表成熟用户心智、又适合作为 AdGenie AI 模板参考的优质品牌品宣视频。  
> 本文是采集、复核、入库和交接的主方法论；题材正式定义见 `ad-video-genres-v1.json` 和生成文档 `广告视频题材分类标准.md`。

---

## 0. 当前数据状态

- `library-v7.json`、`consumer-electronics-review-v3.json` 和 `AdGenie能力需求表-v9.xlsx` 是旧规则下的历史快照。
- 上一轮声称接受的 129 条消费电子候选没有完成独立的广告属性、年代、AI 生成价值和全量视觉题材审核，因此不能继续视为已通过的新核心模板库。
- `consumer-electronics-review-v4.json` / `AdGenie能力需求表-v10.xlsx` 完成 193 条候选全量语义重审，保留 59 条核心模板母片。
- `consumer-electronics-review-v5.json` / `AdGenie能力需求表-v11.xlsx` 追加缺口补采审核：新增 23 条审核记录，其中 14 条进入核心模板，9 条排除或待复核不入库。
- 2026-08-01 起，新增和既有样片都必须通过本文的七道审核门。不引用旧工作簿中的覆盖数量作为有效供给结论。
- 旧文件保留用于审计；新结果生成新版本，不覆盖旧工作簿。

## 1. 方法论维护

### 单一事实源

| 内容 | 唯一维护位置 | 其他载体 |
|---|---|---|
| 采集与模板资格规则 | `采集方案与优质判定标准.md` | Excel `5_收集方法论` 只能从这里摘录，不单独发明规则 |
| 29 个题材定义 | `ad-video-genres-v1.json` | `广告视频题材分类标准.md` 和 Excel `1_广告类型题材` 由它生成 |
| 消费电子商品分类 | `consumer-electronics-taxonomy-v1.json` | 工作簿商品品类 sheet 由它生成 |
| 消费电子专项要求 | `采集方案与优质判定标准-v2.md` | 只写专项增量，不重复主方法论全文 |

### 规则变更流程

1. 记录触发规则变化的具体案例和原判断错误。
2. 判断它属于来源、内容性质、题材、年代、AI 价值还是去重计数问题。
3. 修改唯一事实源，不在多个 Markdown、Excel 和脚本中分别手改。
4. 将案例加入回归表；可以自动执行的判断同时进入校验脚本或阻止列表。
5. 对受影响的数据全量重审，而不是只对已发现的视频 ID 打补丁。
6. 生成新版本工作簿并记录规则版本、重审范围和未完成项。

## 2. 分类目标

### 题材分类追求成熟心智，不追求理论互斥

题材名称的价值在于：行业、用户、内容团队和检索平台已经对某种广告内容形成稳定、可理解的认知。判断标准是：

- 品牌、代理商、案例库、创作者和用户是否反复使用相近名称。
- 内容团队看到标签、定义和边界后，能否知道该生产什么。
- 能否据此形成有效检索词，并稳定判断搜索结果是否匹配。
- 产品用户能否按商品品类和题材筛选模板，而不需要先理解抽象传播理论。

因此一条视频可以多标签。多标签不是为了增加覆盖率，而是承认成熟内容形态可能复合存在。

### 主题材与次题材

- 内部审核先确定 1 个主题材：最能代表观看预期和内容骨架的标签。
- 次题材只有在视频中存在独立、连续、可指认的画面证据时才成立。
- 标题、搜索词、播放列表名称和单个画面瞬间不能直接成为标签。
- 当前工作簿可以继续只展示多标签，不新增用户未要求的字段；主题材用于内部审核和冲突裁决。

正式 29 题材、定义、成立证据、排除边界、检索语义和 TopView 映射统一见 `ad-video-genres-v1.json`。

## 3. 七道审核门

每道门解决不同问题，不能用前一道的结果替代后一道。

### Gate 1：搜索召回

目标是尽量发现候选，不做最终分类。

查询模板：

```text
{品牌} {商品品类} {题材检索语义} site:youtube.com
{品牌} {产品型号} official commercial site:youtube.com
{品牌} {战役名} campaign film site:youtube.com
```

- `official how to`、`official features video` 等查询只说明候选从哪条检索路径被召回。
- `discovery_matches.target_genre` 只能保存在召回证据中，禁止直接复制为正式 `genres`。
- 稀缺真人题材可从专业创作者和垂类账号召回，但来源必须如实记录。

### Gate 2：链接、发布者与母片真实性

- URL 必须来自真实公开结果，禁止构造。
- 确认可播放、标题与内容一致，并能够继续审片。
- 分开记录品牌主频道、品牌地区频道、品牌支持频道、制作方、媒体和创作者。
- 同一实质母片的地区上传、语言版、字幕版和长度剪辑建立同一 `canonical_master_id`，选择最完整、最清晰、来源最直接的代表版本。

来源优先级不等于模板资格：品牌官方只能证明发布者关系，不能证明内容是广告。

### Gate 3：内容性质

先回答“它是什么内容”，再判断题材：

| 内容性质 | 核心模板默认处理 |
|---|---|
| 品牌商业广告 / 产品品宣片 | 继续审核 |
| 广告化产品介绍 | 继续审核 |
| 品牌支持教程 / Quick Start / 排错 | 默认进入支持内容参考，不进入品牌品宣核心模板；存在明确广告化成片证据时人工例外 |
| 完整发布会 / 直播回放 | 排除 |
| 独立媒体测评 / 创作者长测评 | 排除品牌品宣核心模板 |
| 幕后花絮 / 拆机 / 制作纪录 | 排除 |
| 品牌纪录片 / 人物纪录片 | 默认只进灵感库 |

审核问题：

1. 视频是在建立购买欲和品牌/产品价值，还是在解决已经购买用户的操作问题？
2. 是否存在广告化钩子、利益表达、产品欲望和品牌收束？
3. 去掉品牌频道身份后，内容本身仍会被行业用户识别为品宣广告吗？

### Gate 4：年代、产品代际与视觉语言

核心模板以当前产品表达为标准，不仅看视频发布日期：

| 年代 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 近 3 年 | 优先；仍需通过其他审核门 |
| 3–5 年 | 产品仍在售或表达仍具代表性、画面不过时才接受 |
| 超过 5 年 | 默认进入历史 / 灵感参考库，不计普通 MVP 核心模板覆盖 |
| 经典例外 | 需人工说明不可替代价值，不计入普通的每格 10 条供给 |

出现过时产品代际、低清画面、旧字幕样式、旧画幅或明显过时制作语言时，即使未满 5 年也可排除。

### Gate 5：题材独立分类

必须综合实际画面、字幕和元数据，按 `ad-video-genres-v1.json` 独立分类：

1. 写出主题材及对应时间段 / 代表帧。
2. 对每个次题材写出独立证据。
3. 对最容易混淆的相邻题材说明排除理由。
4. 无足够证据时标为待复核，不继承搜索题材。

高频边界：

- `Feature Callout`：卖点、参数、利益点、功能图标或视觉标注。
- `How-To Tutorial`：有顺序的连接、设置、佩戴、操作或排错步骤。
- 操作步骤文字不能因为“有字幕”就重复标为 `Feature Callout`。
- `Product Demo` 回答功能如何工作；`How-To` 回答用户按什么顺序完成任务。
- `Unboxing` 必须有包装从关闭到打开、取出产品与配件的真实连续过程。
- `Daily Routine` 必须有紧凑、可复制的连续生活流程；一个生活镜头或人物纪录片慢铺垫不成立。

### Gate 6：AI 可生成性与生成价值

这两项分别判断：

- `AI 可生成性`：现有模型和制作链路能否较稳定地生成主要镜头。
- `AI 生成价值`：即使能生成，把它做成模板是否能给用户带来明显创意和制作收益。

核心模板至少满足：

- 至少 3 个独立、可描述、可生成的视觉段落。
- 镜头具备场景、构图、运动、材质、光影、动态图形或产品交互中的至少两类发挥空间。
- 产品、使用动作、结果或卖点是画面主体，静音后仍能理解主要内容。
- 不是以白底手动操作、屏幕录制、静态步骤页、单一固定机位或同一人物口播为主体。
- 模板结构可以迁移到同品类的其他商品，而不是依赖特定名人、真实人生、历史事件或不可复现现场。

推荐量化检查：

- 均匀抽取 10 帧，并补充场景切换帧。
- 同一人物正面讲话达到 6/10 帧，默认判为口播主导。
- 产品、使用、功效或卖点相关视觉少于 3/10 帧，默认产品主体不足。
- 前 5 秒没有产品、痛点、利益或视觉钩子时，需要人工说明为什么仍有模板价值。
- `frames_reviewed = 10` 只表示取得 10 帧；必须另有视觉判断和证据，不能把帧数当成审核完成。

### Gate 7：核心模板资格与计数

进入 MVP 核心模板库必须同时满足：

- 链接和来源可核验。
- 内容性质是品牌商业广告、产品品宣或经人工批准的广告化内容。
- 年代与产品代际符合核心库要求。
- 至少一个正式题材有实际画面证据。
- AI 可生成性和 AI 生成价值均通过。
- 时长为 16–119 秒；16–17 秒仍需检查信息密度，120 秒及以上直接排除。
- 不是重复母片。

计数键：

```text
商品品类 + 题材 + canonical_master_id
```

同一母片可以贡献多个真正成立的题材，但在同一格只计一次。每格目标 10 条不构成降低质量门槛的理由。

## 4. 10 点 Storyboard 审核要求

`bradautomates/claude-video` 可用于建立证据链，但不能代替判断：

1. 读取公开标题、发布者、时长和发布日期。
2. 获取字幕；字幕缺失时以画面为主。
3. 在 0%、10%……90% 采帧，并补充重要场景切换。
4. 审核者必须真正查看画面并记录内容性质、题材证据、口播占比、产品主体和 AI 价值。
5. 不能稳定加载足够帧时标记待复核，不提前入库。

建议内部 review 数据分别保存：

```json
{
  "publisher_role": "brand_support_channel",
  "content_nature": "support_tutorial",
  "primary_genre": "How-To Tutorial",
  "secondary_genres": [],
  "recency_status": "over_5_years",
  "ai_generatable": true,
  "ai_generation_value": "low",
  "core_template_eligible": false,
  "decision_reason_codes": ["SUPPORT_CONTENT", "LOW_AI_CREATIVE_HEADROOM"]
}
```

这些是内部审核字段，不代表本轮向 Excel 新增展示字段。

## 5. 直接排除规则

任一项命中即不进入普通 MVP 核心模板：

| 代码 | 规则 |
|---|---|
| `DURATION_OUT_OF_RANGE` | ≤15 秒或 ≥120 秒；16–17 秒内容单薄也排除 |
| `SUPPORT_CONTENT` | 支持教程、Quick Start、安装设置或排错内容，且缺少广告化品宣表达 |
| `EVENT_OR_LAUNCH` | 完整发布会、直播回放或以舞台演讲为主体 |
| `BEHIND_THE_SCENES` | 幕后、制作花絮、拍摄纪录 |
| `DOCUMENTARY_STYLE` | 人物背景、真实经历或日常环境慢铺垫，产品弱露出 |
| `TALKING_HEAD_DOMINANT` | 同一人物正面讲话主导，视觉变化和产品段落不足 |
| `PRODUCT_NOT_VISUAL_SUBJECT` | 无法回答卖什么、为什么买，或产品相关视觉少于 3/10 帧 |
| `OUTDATED_PRODUCT_OR_VISUALS` | 超过 5 年且无经典例外，或产品代际、画面语言明显过时 |
| `LOW_AI_CREATIVE_HEADROOM` | 以白底手动操作、录屏、静态步骤页为主，缺乏可生成视觉段落 |
| `SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED` | 链接、发布者或内容无法核验 |
| `DUPLICATE_MASTER` | 同一实质母片已有代表版本 |

## 6. 四个分类与入库回归案例

| 视频 ID | 正确题材判断 | 核心模板判断 | 回归要求 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xa1LGVWoy30` | `How-To Tutorial` 成立；`Feature Callout` 不成立 | Bose 品牌支持教程，不是品牌品宣；排除 | 不能因官方频道或 How-To 搜索词进入 TVC / 核心库 |
| `H1R_YQLiGzk` | `Unboxing` 可以成立 | 2020-08-30 发布，当前接近 6 年且产品代际过时；排除普通核心库 | 年代门必须独立于题材成立执行 |
| `a6zDDcGjFtM` | `How-To Tutorial` 成立；`Feature Callout` 不成立 | 白底手动 Quick Start，AI 创意发挥空间低；排除 | 步骤字幕不能误算卖点标注，分类成立不等于模板资格成立 |
| `s2lowSj9k-s` | 主题材为 `Feature Callout`；可复核 `Macro Close-Up` / `Product Demo` | 卖点字幕驱动的品牌产品短片，可继续复核 | 不能因为由 How-To 查询召回就标成 How-To |
| `QgsTaSS0CI4` | `Multi-Angle / 360° Product Showcase` 成立；`Unboxing` 不成立 | Huawei FreeBuds Pro 3 官方产品造型/材质展示，可入库 | 标题或召回词命中 Unboxing 时，必须检查是否存在真实开盒取出过程 |
| `lsE4YqFVrWs` | `Product Demo` / `Feature Callout` / `Macro Close-Up` / `Multi-Angle` 成立；`Unboxing` 不成立 | CUKTECH 官方产品功能片，可入库 | 有包装词、First Look 或 Product Performance 不等于开箱 |
| `GWJ3aNko7Uw` | `Feature Callout` / `Product Demo` / `Multi-Angle` 成立；`Daily Routine` 不成立 | Baseus 官方产品功能片，可入库 | 一个或少量生活使用镜头不能自动算 Daily Routine，必须有连续日常流程 |
| `CDYM7t0fZjE` | `TVC / Brand Commercial` 成立；`Walk-and-Talk UGC` 和 `Lookbook` 不成立 | Beats 明星概念广告，可入库为 TVC | 明星/造型/时尚感不等于 Lookbook；非手持边走边讲不能算 Walk-and-Talk |
| `sCYrElLdURQ` | `How-To Tutorial` 成立 | JBL 官方 Quick Tip，视觉段落单一，本轮不入品牌品宣核心模板 | How-To 可以作为题材存在，但要另过内容性质和 AI 生成价值门 |
| `-ggrxRcWFxI` | `Multi-Angle` 可以成立，但商品品类不是 Power Banks | Belkin 无线充电器，排除当前 MVP 品类 | 先判主商品品类，再判题材；不能因品牌和充电语义相近而跨品类计数 |

前三条加入核心模板阻止列表；第四条作为正向分类回归，不因检索路径被错误降级。

## 7. 行业与消费电子商品分类

核心行业：

`Consumer Electronics` · `Skincare` · `Color Cosmetics` · `Fragrance` · `Personal Care` · `Jewelry & Watches` · `Apparel & Footwear` · `Bags & Accessories` · `Home Appliances & Living` · `Food & Beverage` · `Sports & Outdoor`

- 按广告中被销售的具体产品和主要消费用途选择 1 个主行业，不按品牌统一分类。
- `Other` 只作系统兜底，不进入核心覆盖率。
- 消费电子继续下钻 34 个商品品类，正式名称与边界见 `consumer-electronics-taxonomy-v1.json`。
- 每条消费电子样片只选择 1 个主商品品类；多产品或跨品类内容只作兜底，不计单品类覆盖率。

## 8. 来源与检索路径

优先顺序：

1. 品牌商业主频道及正式 Campaign / Commercial / Product Film 播放列表。
2. 明确的代理商、制作公司、导演或奖项库发布。
3. 对 UGC、Testimonial、Vox Pop 等品牌官方稀缺题材，使用可信专业创作者或垂类账号。
4. 品牌支持频道只用于发现教程心智和支持内容，不默认作为品牌品宣核心样片来源。

奖项、品牌知名度、官方认证和经典地位只证明来源或行业价值，不能替代内容性质、年代和 AI 模板审核。

## 9. 失败模式

| 失败模式 | 根因 | 修正 |
|---|---|---|
| 搜索题材直接污染正式标签 | 将召回查询当成视觉分类结果 | 搜索证据与正式标签分字段保存，正式标签必须有画面证据 |
| 获得 10 帧就当成完成审核 | `frames_reviewed` 只统计文件数量 | 保存视觉判断、时间段和理由码，并做语义回归 |
| AI 适配循环自证 | “已接受且有题材”被直接当成 AI 适配 | 独立判断可生成性、生成价值和核心模板资格 |
| 品牌官方与品牌品宣混为一谈 | 频道匹配只看品牌名 | 分开记录发布者角色和内容性质 |
| 年代偏好没有执行 | 文档写近 5 年，代码只拦 8 年以上 | 超过 5 年默认退出普通核心库，经典例外单独审批 |
| 用视频 ID 补丁代替全量审核 | 只修已发现案例 | 规则变化后对受影响集合全量重审，并保留固定回归案例 |
| 为覆盖数量硬塞样片 | 把每格 10 条当成质量要求 | 数量是供给目标，质量门是入库条件；不足保持缺口 |

## 10. 记录与验证

面向样片库的基本字段保持不变：

```json
{
  "industry": "Consumer Electronics",
  "product_category": "True Wireless / Bluetooth Earbuds",
  "brand": "Example Brand",
  "title": "Original video title",
  "url": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=example",
  "genres": ["Feature Callout", "Product Demo"],
  "source_type": "品牌官方",
  "note": "发布日期、产品代际和关键判断"
}
```

每轮提交前至少验证：

- 题材 JSON 可解析、数量为 29、英文标签唯一、分组合法。
- 入库脚本的合法题材与题材事实源完全一致。
- 四个回归案例符合预期。
- 正式标签与搜索召回标签没有自动继承关系。
- 所有接受样片有内容性质、年代、视觉证据、AI 价值和母片去重判断。
- 工作簿数量与重审后的 review 数据一致，但数据一致性不能代替语义正确性。

## 11. 下一步执行顺序

1. 先按本文重构候选 review 结构和审核逻辑。
2. 对真无线与蓝牙耳塞、充电宝的既有候选全量重审，不沿用 v3 的 ID 增删补丁。
3. 每条先判断内容性质和年代，再独立视觉分类，最后判断 AI 核心模板资格。
4. 输出通过、灵感参考、待复核和排除四类结果，并保留理由码。
5. 在真实有效供给基础上重新统计每个商品品类 × 题材的去重母片数。
6. 生成新的工作簿版本，不覆盖 v9。

# 消费电子 MVP 样片采集专项补充

> 版本：v4（2026-08-01）  
> 本文只记录消费电子专项范围和额外约束。通用审核门、题材定义、AI 价值、回归案例和计数规则以 `采集方案与优质判定标准.md` 与 `ad-video-genres-v1.json` 为准。  
> 本文不再由 `build_library_v6.mjs` 覆盖生成。

## 1. MVP 范围

首批优先商品品类：

- `True Wireless / Bluetooth Earbuds`（真无线与蓝牙耳塞）
- `Power Banks`（充电宝）

产品视图采用“商品品类 × 广告题材 × 去重母片”。每格目标为 10 条有效模板，但数量目标不能降低质量门槛。

## 2. 首批 10 个题材

1. `TVC / Brand Commercial`
2. `Macro Close-Up`
3. `Multi-Angle / 360° Product Showcase`
4. `Feature Callout`
5. `Product Demo`
6. `How-To Tutorial`
7. `Unboxing`
8. `Lookbook`
9. `Daily Routine`
10. `Walk-and-Talk UGC`

标签定义和边界不在本文复制，统一读取 `ad-video-genres-v1.json`。

## 3. 消费电子额外要求

- 核心样片优先来自当前行业 Top 品牌的商业主频道和正式产品 / Campaign 内容。
- 品牌支持频道、Quick Start、Proper Fit、Setup、Troubleshooting 等内容默认是支持教程，不是品牌品宣核心模板。
- 产品发布超过 5 年或已明显退出当前主流产品代际时，默认只进历史 / 灵感参考库。
- 白底手动操作、App 录屏、静态步骤页或单一手部演示占主体时，即使 How-To 分类成立，也通常判为低 AI 生成价值。
- 15 秒及以下直接排除；16–17 秒还要检查是否有足够内容密度；120 秒及以上直接排除。
- `Feature Callout` 必须表达卖点、参数或用户利益；操作步骤文字不能重复算卖点标注。
- `How-To Tutorial` 必须有可跟随的顺序步骤，但题材成立不等于核心模板资格成立。
- 稀缺题材找不到高质量样片时保留空缺，不用相邻题材、普通 TVC 或官方支持教程替代。

## 4. 计数

```text
product_category + genre + canonical_master_id
```

- 同一母片在同一商品品类 × 题材中只计一次。
- 地区上传、语言版、字幕版和长度剪辑不能增加计数。
- 同一视频的多个题材标签必须分别有画面证据，但不能把同一视频重复解释成 10 条样片。

## 5. 历史结果状态

旧流程声称接受 129 条以及由此产生的题材覆盖数量，均来自尚未落实新七道审核门的流程。它们保留为历史快照，不能继续视为已经通过的 MVP 核心模板供给。

`consumer-electronics-review-v4.json` 已对 193 条候选完成全量语义重审，保留 59 条核心模板母片。

`consumer-electronics-review-v5.json` 在 v4 基础上追加缺口补采审核：新增 23 条审核记录，其中 14 条入库、9 条排除或待复核不入库。

当前 v5 / v11 的两个 MVP 优先品类覆盖状态：

| 商品品类 | 已达 ≥10 的题材 | 仍不足的题材 |
|---|---|---|
| `True Wireless / Bluetooth Earbuds` | `TVC / Brand Commercial`、`Macro Close-Up`、`Multi-Angle / 360° Product Showcase`、`Feature Callout`、`Product Demo` | `How-To Tutorial`、`Unboxing`、`Lookbook`、`Daily Routine`、`Walk-and-Talk UGC` |
| `Power Banks` | `TVC / Brand Commercial`、`Macro Close-Up`、`Multi-Angle / 360° Product Showcase`、`Feature Callout`、`Product Demo` | `How-To Tutorial`、`Unboxing`、`Lookbook`、`Daily Routine`、`Walk-and-Talk UGC` |

继续补采必须读取 `consumer-electronics-review-v5.json` 作为当前事实源，不能继续使用 `revise_consumer_electronics_v3.mjs` 的视频 ID 增删补丁作为最终分类结果。

## 6. 本轮新增边界案例

- `QgsTaSS0CI4`：Huawei FreeBuds Pro 3 是产品造型/材质展示，不是 Unboxing。
- `lsE4YqFVrWs`：CUKTECH Power Bank 是功能/卖点/多角度展示，不是 Unboxing。
- `GWJ3aNko7Uw`：Baseus Power Bank 有生活使用镜头，但不是连续 Daily Routine。
- `CDYM7t0fZjE`：Beats Emma 概念广告可入 TVC，但不是 Walk-and-Talk UGC，也不硬标 Lookbook。
- `sCYrElLdURQ`：JBL 官方 How-To 成立，但 Quick Tip / 手动操作主导，本轮不进入品牌品宣核心模板。
- `-ggrxRcWFxI`：Belkin Magnetic Foldable Wireless Charger 是无线充电器，不计入 Power Banks。

collection_plan: 按 Best Ads 的 TV、国家、类别和 2025/2026 年份入口遍历列表页，并使用 checkpoint 保存每个候选的终态。
